topic: Adding frequency data for specific category
summary_markdown: The discussion focused on ensuring a specific category (7942, Mall) receives accurate frequency tracking. Initially, [p1] requested adding this category to an existing SQL query structure. After determining the data could not be added directly into the specified location, it was decided that the logic needed to be implemented higher up in the code using copy-paste methods. Ultimately, the necessary changes were implemented on both production and staging environments.
decisions: The frequency calculation for category 7942 (Mall) must be ensured.
The implementation of this frequency data required modifying the SQL structure at a higher level.
